name: Terraform Provider for Fabric V1.11.0
description: # Fabric Terraform Provider Changes## New Resources and Data Sources| Feature | Type | Description ||---|---|---|| `fabric_operations_agent` | Data source | Added support for retrieving Operations Agent configuration || `fabric_operations_agent` | Resource | Added support for managing Operations Agent resources || `fabric_data_agent` | Data source | Added support for retrieving Data Agent configuration || `fabric_data_agent` | Resource | Added support for managing Data Agent resources || `fabric_eventstream_destination_connection` | Data source | Added support for retrieving Eventstream Destination Connection configuration || `fabric_eventstream_destination_connection` | Ephemeral resource | Added support for ephemeral Eventstream Destination Connection operations || `fabric_warehouse_sql_audit_settings` | Resource | Added support for managing Warehouse SQL Audit Settings || `fabric_warehouse_sql_audit_settings` | Data source | Added support for retrieving Warehouse SQL Audit Settings |## Enhancements| Feature | Type | Description ||---|---|---|| `shortcut_conflict_policy` attribute in `fabric_shortcut` resource | Enhancement | Added support for configuring shortcut conflict handling behavior || `one_drive_share_point` attribute in `fabric_shortcut` resource | Enhancement | Added support for OneDrive and SharePoint shortcut configuration || `one_drive_share_point` attribute in `fabric_shortcut` data source | Enhancement | Added support for retrieving OneDrive and SharePoint shortcut configuration || `allow_usage_in_user_controlled_code` attribute in `fabric_connection` resource and data source | Enhancement | Added support for controlling usage in user-controlled code scenarios || DataPipeline Execute job type support in `fabric_item_job_scheduler` resource and data source | Enhancement | Added support for scheduling and retrieving DataPipeline Execute job types |## SummaryThis update expands Fabric Terraform provider capabilities with:- New support for Fabric Agents resources and data sources- Eventstream destination connection support- Warehouse SQL Audit Settings management- Enhanced shortcut configuration capabilities- Improved connection configuration controls- Additional DataPipeline job scheduling support
